theme: Roadmap Reality and Sprint Status Integrity

shots.title: Preserve ticket dependencies during roadmap sync and refuse broad destructive rewrites (#568)
shots.notes: Roadmap sync now marks scorecard-backed sprints complete and merges scorecard-derived ticket fields into existing tickets so metadata such as depends_on and github_issue survives.

shots.title: Correct shipped-sprint attribution so post-merge housekeeping commits do not ship the next planned sprint (#563, #568)
shots.notes: Shipped-sprint detection now parses git history per commit and ignores subject sprint refs when a commit only touches SLOPE metadata, while still counting scorecard artifacts as shipped evidence.

shots.title: Derive closeout-ready sprint status when all gates are complete instead of leaving phase planning active (#567)
shots.notes: `slope sprint status` now reports derived status ready_for_pr when all gates are complete, keeps the stored phase as context, and prints the PR/retro next action.

shots.title: Add regression fixtures for roadmap sync, shipped attribution, and all-gates-complete status (#568, #563, #567)
shots.notes: Regression coverage now spans roadmap sync metadata preservation, metadata-only shipped attribution, and complete-gates sprint status output.

conditions.description: Roadmap ticket metadata lives outside the narrow scorecard-derived fields, so sync needed to update durable execution data without wiping manually-authored dependency and GitHub issue context.
Post-merge housekeeping commits can mention the next planned sprint in their subject while only shipping prior-sprint SLOPE artifacts.

training.description: Roadmap sync should treat scorecards as shipment evidence without treating them as the whole sprint definition.
training.outcome: The sync path refreshes scorecard-owned fields, sets scorecard-backed sprints complete, and preserves per-ticket metadata.

training.description: Shipped-sprint attribution needs commit-level file context, not a repo-wide union of subjects and paths.
training.outcome: Metadata-only post-merge commits no longer ship the next planned sprint just because their subject names it.

training.description: Lifecycle output should report derived readiness when gates make the stored phase misleading.
training.outcome: Complete sprint gates now surface ready_for_pr and the concrete PR/retro next action.

nutrition.description: `pnpm test tests/cli/roadmap.test.ts tests/core/analyzers/git.test.ts tests/cli/sprint-workflow.test.ts` passed: 3 files, 92 tests.
`node dist/cli/index.js roadmap validate --path=docs/backlog/roadmap.json` passed with only existing historical ticket-count warnings.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A tidy trust-recovery sprint: three small user-facing inconsistencies all came from durable state being interpreted too broadly or too narrowly.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When adding SLOPE automation around roadmap state, keep scorecard evidence, manually-authored roadmap metadata, and post-merge artifacts as separate signals until the command has enough context to merge them safely.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The status wording bug was not a state-machine failure; it was an output contract failure where all gates were done but the display still centered the stale stored phase.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S155 can build on this by making review-gate provenance just as explicit as sprint shipment and closeout readiness are now.

bunker_locations: Scorecard sync can accidentally strip roadmap-only ticket metadata if it replaces tickets wholesale.
Post-merge housekeeping commit subjects can mention a planned sprint without shipping that sprint.
Stored sprint phase alone can be misleading after all closeout gates pass.
yardage_book_updates: src/cli/commands/roadmap.ts now merges scorecard-derived ticket fields into existing ticket objects and marks scorecard-backed sprints complete.
src/core/analyzers/git.ts now parses shipped-sprint history per commit and suppresses subject refs for SLOPE metadata-only commits.
src/cli/commands/sprint.ts now shows ready_for_pr when all gates are complete and prints the PR/retro next action.
Regression coverage was added in tests/cli/roadmap.test.ts, tests/core/analyzers/git.test.ts, and tests/cli/sprint-workflow.test.ts.
